timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In this activity, we will observe the rectilinear motion of an object.
We all know the rectilinear motion of an object is the motion of an object in a straight line or a straight path.
For this activity, we need a glass marble, we need poster colour and a white sheet.
We take a glass marble, put it in a colour and it should be thickly coated with the colour.
Roll it on a white sheet of paper.
What do we observe? We observe the movement of the marble in a straight line.
This shows that the marble moves in a straight line or a rectilinear motion.
So we define rectilinear motion as the motion of an object in a straight line.
